title: KestrelCare Recovery Aging Table
content:
**Rule.** On the recovery of a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts claim payment made in error, an aged-recovery share applies, counted in calendar days from the payment date to the day of the recovery: beyond 90 days (the long aged-recovery days) and within the recovery window the plan recovers the old-payment share of 75 percent; beyond 30 days (the short aged-recovery days) but not beyond 90 days it recovers the mid-age share of 90 percent; within 30 days it recovers the whole error.

| Calendar days since the payment | Share recovered |
|---|---|
| 0 to 30 | 100 percent |
| 31 to 90 | 90 percent |
| 91 up to the end of the recovery window | 75 percent |

The share is taken of the error measured on the payment.

*Hypothetical:* an error of 400.00 recovered 30 days after the payment is recovered at 400.00; at 31 days, 360.00; at 91 days, 300.00.
